title: Measure Closed-Loop Latency and Action Dropouts
summary: An inference that finishes after its control deadline is not equivalent to an action applied on time.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: All times and deadline are milliseconds on one synchronized monotonic clock; rates dimensionless.

physical_contract.axes: observed_ms(T), applied_ms(T) -> latency_ms(T) and summary scalars
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Each applied entry corresponds to exactly its observed entry; no timestamp matching is inferred.
physical_contract.batching: observed_ms(T), applied_ms(T) -> latency_ms(T) and summary scalars

provenance.authoring_notes: Original measurement exercise motivated by RT-1 control-time efficiency; no proprietary robot telemetry or published latency number is reproduced.
